part_name: SCE20 R2 aluminum mounting panel for stacked layout
assumptions: Factory outline and holes are interfaces; preserve R6.35 even though not a style ladder radius.
Catalog mounting cavities represented in STEP; actual production cavities are defined solely by native FPD hardware objects.
The Bedrock adapter remains seated directly on the main aluminum panel; the independent removable carrier places the router above it.
The unused upper-left area is intentional; cosmetic features must not consume this reserved space.
